rules.description: You may not be eligible to receive the welcome offer, intro APR offer, and intro plan fee offer if you have or have had this Card, the Cash Magnet® Card, the Blue Cash Preferred® Card, the Morgan Stanley Blue Cash Preferred® American Express Card or previous versions of these Cards.

You also may not be eligible to receive a welcome offer based on various factors, such as your history with credit card balance transfers, your history as an American Express Card Member, the number of credit cards that you have opened and closed and other factors.

recurring_credits.description: Up to $7/month statement credit on Disney+, Hulu, or Plus.espn.com U.S. subscriptions or bundles. Enrollment required.
